title: Xbox executive claims widespread AI use in gaming despite user skepticism
excerpt: A Hindustan Times summary attributes claims about extensive AI use in gaming to Xbox executive Brandon Stirrup.
author: LokkeeVerse Editorial
content:
Xbox executive Brandon Stirrup claimed gaming companies use AI extensively despite negative sentiment among users, according to the supplied Hindustan Times summary.

Stirrup also said he built a mini-game in three hours. The metadata provides no further details about the development process or evidence establishing the scale of AI adoption across gaming companies.

The available information supports reporting these statements as attributed claims, rather than confirmed findings about the industry.
